title: Arizer Air & Solo Stem Cap Pack
description:
This listing is for stem caps only, aroma tube not included.

Silicone Stem Caps. Made with high quality silicone, food / medical grade, heat rated for use with cool & hot Glass Aroma Tubes.

Compatible with Arizer Air aroma tubes and Arizer Solo aroma tubes

Can be used for pre-loading or for protecting from the hot glass surface.

These are manufacturer recommended caps from Arizer.

Can be used when pre-loading Glass Aroma Tubes, and / or protecting pockets, purses, and surfaces from hot glass. – See more at: https://arizer.com/store/en/arizer-air-parts-accessories/105-stem-cap-pack.html#sthash.gx0pcx69.dpuf
